fullContent:
Ajmodadi Churna – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Refernce: Rasatantra Saar 
 Introduction 
 Ajmodadi Churna is a powdered herbal formulation. It is a superior medicine for Rheumatoid Arthritis. Ajmod or Celery is the main ingredient of this formulation. It’s very light to digest and pierces through the deep tissues in order to heal them. It also heals Vata and Kapha. It has a hot potency. 
 Ingredients

 Zingiber officinale 
 120 grams 
 
 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Clean and grind all the ingredients all the ingredients to a fine powder and mix equal amount of jaggery in it and mix it properly. Make tablets of 1 grams each. And store it in an air tight container. 
 Properties 
 It is a poly herbal classical formulation which is available in powder form. These herbs of Ajmodadi churna have ability to balance the kapha and vata doshas and their related diseases. It has anti-inflammatory properties which is very effective to reduce the inflammation in rheumatism, sciatica, neuralgic pain etc. It is very effective natural remedy for arthritis that provides quick comfort to the joints. It is good for all types of joint pain and inflammation. It also possess carminative properties which help to reduce the vata doshas. It helps to improve the activity of muscles and bones and reduces the inflammation and discomfort. Use of this medicines is useful in all types of joint pain such as backache, pain in lower back, pain in thigh, pain in anorectal area, neuralgic pain and knee pain. Apart from this it has anti-helminthic and anti-spasmodic properties that destroy the parasitic worms. It also improves the digestion and appetite. It helps to remove the toxins from the body and clear channels via antioxidant and purifying properties. 
 Indications 
 
 Rheumatoid arthritis 
 Osteoarthritis 
 Joint pains 
 Sciatica 
 Spondylitis 
 Any kind of joint pains 
 Osteoporosis 
 
 Dosage 
 Powder can be consumed in a quantity of 2-3 grams. In case of tablets, you can consume 2-3 tablets at once. Twice or thrice a day. 
 Contraindications 
 
 It should not be consumed during pregnancy as it might cause contractions. 
 Over dosage should be discouraged. 
 It should be taken under strict medical advice. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
